build_sts_gateway: build a python module that creates an STSGateway instance with a given AWS region and optional access keys
create_sts_client: create an STSGateway that initializes a boto3 STS client for a specified AWS region
get_caller_arn: get the AWS caller identity ARN by calling get_caller_arn on an STSGateway instance
review_stsgateway_class: review the STSGateway class and its get_caller_arn method for AWS STS integration
refactor_stsgateway_init: refactor the STSGateway constructor to support additional boto3 STS client configuration options
